name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The U.S. launched an 11th consecutive night of strikes against Iran on Tuesday. CBS News' Weijia Jiang reports on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's earlier testimony about the Pentagon's request for additional funding. Then, Washington Post national security reporter Noah Robertson joins with analysis.

changes.title: Severe labor shortage could emerge in the U.S. over the next 10-15 years, population scientist says
changes.summary: The U.S. is set to face a severe labor shortage in the next 10 to 15 years, a leading population scientist says. CBS MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo has more.

changes.title: Staying in a job for the health insurance? About 1 in 4 Americans do, a survey says
changes.summary: About 24% of U.S. employees stay in unwanted jobs just for health insurance, a report out Wednesday finds. Up significantly since 2021, the uptick in "job lock" is a concerning sign for the U.S. economy. (Image credit: Creative Images Lab).

changes.title: Mamdani Calls Netanyahu a ‘War Criminal’ and Calls on U.S. to Arrest Him
changes.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani challenged the United States to execute an international arrest warrant against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, which New York itself cannot do.

changes.title: U.S. identifies 3rd service member ‘believed’ killed in Iranian attack
changes.summary: The United States military identified Angel S. Rampersad as a third servicemember believed to have been killed in Jordan after an Iranian attack last Friday.

changes.title: Trump approves landmark U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal
changes.summary: President Donald Trump has approved a landmark civilian nuclear deal between the United States and Saudi Arabia that is expected to be announced Wednesday, a senior administration official told NBC News.

changes.title: U.S. and Iranian attacks continue as tensions mount on a key waterway in the Red Sea
changes.summary: The attacks overshadowed diplomatic efforts in Pakistan, one of the conflict's mediators, where a senior Iranian official held talks potentially aimed at reviving a collapsed ceasefire between the United States and Iran. (Image credit: Atta Kenare).

changes.title: Trump to attend dignified transfer of fallen soldiers. And, Hegseth testifies on Iran
changes.summary: Trump will attend the dignified transfer of U.S. service members killed in the Middle East. And, Pete Hegseth is requesting billions from Congress to help with the rising cost of the war in Iran. (Image credit: Saul Loeb).

changes.title: Trump’s 50% Tariffs on Canada: What to Know, and What’s Next
changes.summary: The president said punishing 50 percent tariffs would begin by Aug. 19, a significant escalation of the trade war between Canada and the U.S. that he started over a year ago.
